resources.string: Unsupported in raw capture: lifecycle, debug and control payloads are excluded.
Never received this session · awaiting normal history sync. This event may be unsupported by this ring.
Never received this session · awaiting a response or push. An unsupported channel may remain empty.
All IBI pairs are retained, including zero and invalid intervals. Quality is the ring’s two-bit flag (good beat = 1), not a health score.
All six decoded IBI and optical amplitude entries remain visible, including zeros.
R-ratio and perfusion are research quantities, not calibrated oxygen percentages. Header width is unresolved; only bytes are decoded.
Raw optical PPG, not cardiovascular age. Delta interpretation and cross-record state are unresolved, so amplitude reconstruction is disabled.
Recorded motion is an averaged signed vector scaled ×8 in record counts. Live 0x33 uses signed 16-bit raw counts; no g calibration is assumed.
Diagnostic fields retain the received values. Byte fields are unsigned payload bytes; no physiological meaning is inferred.
Push delivery follows the ring. Selecting a read interval does not change the physical sensor sample rate.
Observes normal history sync only. Selecting an event never restarts a history download.
Observed request-to-response timing has no request ID: replies with the same operation cannot be uniquely correlated. Queue, GATT completion and response times are separate.
Queue %1$s ms · GATT completion %2$s ms · observed response %3$s ms
Latest response / record received %1$d seconds ago
Observed receipts %1$s Hz · last inter-arrival %2$s ms
Ring measurement time unavailable on this response.
Ring tick %1$s · measurement epoch unavailable in this raw view.
Statistics and plots use the retained session window: %1$d records of this channel, up to 256 total records / 64 KiB / 32768 numeric values.
Record framing: type, length, u32 LE ring tick, payload. Byte fields index payload; display below includes the complete frame in hex, decimal and escaped text.
Response framing: operation, length, body (secure: sub-operation then body). Byte fields index the body after any sub-operation. Hex, decimal bytes and escaped text follow.
Volatile session evidence only. Evicted: %1$d records / %2$d bytes / %3$d values. Oversized records omitted: %4$d. Nothing leaves this device.
Receipt time → %1$s seconds retained. Record values share receipt time; this is not measurement-time history.
Waiting for authenticated idle boundary after startup / history / live OFF.
Response timed out. Polling is stalled until a new connection; no uncertain request is repeated.
Display only: HR uses the existing 3-second trend; other fields use a 250 ms trend. Numbers and bytes retain actual values.
